description: Wire existing snow_connector.py (built 2026-04-16) into approval_workflow daemon on port 8780. MUST: (1) Register snow_connector as a write_service consumer watching mcp_decisions table for new rows with status='APPROVED' or 'REJECTED'; (2) Transform each decision into SNOW ticket payload with verdict, signal scores summary, and attestation reference; (3) POST to SNOW inbound webhook endpoint (configurable via SNOW_WEBHOOK_URL env var); (4) Handle 429/503 with exponential backoff (3 tries, max 30s per call); (5) Log all outbound calls to audit_log with action='snow_ticket_created'; (6) NEVER hardcode SNOW credentials — use os.environ.get() for all secrets; (7) Include X-API-Key header for SNOW auth if required. Do NOT rebuild snow_connector.py itself — it already exists.
